morning.insight:
💡 반도체 쓰나미가 시장을 바꿨다

SK하이닉스 매출 100조 돌파는 단순 이벤트가 아니라 HBM·AI 메모리 수요의 구조적 전환을 확인시킨 신호입니다. 앤트로픽 IPO S-1 제출과 맞물리며 AI 밸류체인 전반에 자금이 재유입되고 있습니다.

6,000선 회복의 의미. 10거래일 만의 6,000선 탈환은 반등의 강도(7/31 이후 최대)와 수급(외인+기관 1.8조 순매수) 면에서 바닥 확인에 가깝습니다. 다만 달러-원 1,337원·국고채 4.108%는 환율·금리 부담이 여전함을 시사합니다. 하루 상승만으로 추세 반전이라 판단하기엔 이르나, AI 호재가 진짜 재료라는 점은 분명합니다.

오늘 체크포인트. 10/30 전사경영전략회의 준비가 D-1. 2027 재무계획 취합이 밀린 상태니 오전 중 마무리 필요. AX-TF 중간 체크도 내일 예정 — AI tool 보고서(밀림)를 먼저 정리하고 체크리스트 준비하길 권합니다.

articles.headline: Fed Expected to Hold Rates in 3.75%-4% Range
articles.body: The Federal Reserve convened for its October meeting and is widely expected to hold the fed funds rate at 3.75%-4%, saving a second hike of the year for December.

articles.headline: Spain's Second High-Speed Train Crash This Year Leaves Dozens Dead
articles.body: A collision of high-speed trains in Spain killed dozens in the country's second such disaster this year, prompting national mourning and an investigation.

articles.headline: Anthropic S-1 Shows Red-Hot Growth, Risks and Massive Computing Costs
articles.body: Anthropic's IPO filing revealed explosive revenue growth alongside huge computing costs, giving investors the clearest look yet at the economics of frontier AI.

articles.headline: Broadcom Arranges $63 Billion Financing for Anthropic Chips
articles.body: Broadcom said it would arrange $63 billion in financing with major banks to fund Anthropic's chip purchases, further stoking AI infrastructure investment.

articles.headline: AI Rally Regains Steam After Anthropic IPO Filing
articles.body: AI and chip stocks rebounded as Anthropic's IPO filing revived enthusiasm, lifting Samsung Electronics and SK hynix by double digits in Korea.

articles.headline: Alphabet Posts Disappointing Revenue; Shares Drop
articles.body: Alphabet reported revenue and income that missed estimates, with shares falling as slowing search growth overshadowed AI optimism.

articles.headline: Meta, Broadcom, SpaceX Drive AI Fundraising Wave
articles.body: Meta sought up to $97.5 billion in stock sales, Broadcom closed a $63 billion financing deal, and SpaceX signed a roughly $40 billion equipment lease.

articles.headline: Oracle Surges 10% on AI Demand
articles.body: Oracle shares jumped more than 10%, leading most active U.S. stocks, as investors bet on its cloud infrastructure for AI workloads.

articles.headline: Oil Rises as Iran War Premium Returns
articles.body: Brent crude traded near $114 a barrel as the risk premium from the Iran conflict returned, while WTI hovered around $102 in New York.

articles.headline: Fed Set to Hold as Traders Bet on December Hike
articles.body: Traders widely expect the Fed to hold rates this week and deliver its final hike of the cycle in December, according to futures pricing.

articles.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro Flees Brazil for the U.S. After Election Defeat
articles.body: The defeated Brazilian presidential candidate left the country after being ordered to surrender his passport, landing in Miami and following the path his father once took.

articles.headline: Israeli Voting Ends After Strong Turnout With No Clear Winner
articles.body: Israel's first national election since the Oct. 7, 2023, attacks drew record turnout but exit polls showed no clear winner, leaving a fragmented result.

articles.headline: Tech Stocks Extend Rally as AI Optimism Returns
articles.body: Technology shares led a second day of gains as Anthropic's IPO filing renewed optimism about the AI buildout, with chip stocks outperforming.

articles.headline: Anthropic IPO Filing Reveals $16.3 Billion in Revenue
articles.body: Anthropic's S-1 showed $16.3 billion in first-half revenue, up from $1.16 billion a year earlier, alongside a large net loss tied to convertible-note charges.

articles.headline: At Least 68 Killed in High-Speed Train Collision in Spain
articles.body: A high-speed train collision in Spain killed at least 68 people, one of the country's deadliest rail disasters, prompting a government investigation.

articles.headline: Inflation Data Undercuts Trump's Economic Claims
articles.body: Fresh inflation data undercut the administration's economic narrative, complicating the GOP's closing midterm message on prices.

articles.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro Lands in Miami After Fleeing Brazil
articles.body: The defeated Brazilian presidential candidate arrived in Miami after being ordered to surrender his passport, deepening a political crisis over his whereabouts.

articles.headline: No Clear Winner in Israeli Vote, Exit Polls Indicate
articles.body: Israel's first national election since the Oct. 7 attacks drew the highest turnout in decades, but exit polls indicated no clear winner.

articles.headline: Record Arab Vote Brings a Painful Dilemma for Israel's Opposition
articles.body: The 19 seats won by Israel's Arab-led parties could be key to toppling Netanyahu — if opposition leaders are willing to work with them.

articles.headline: Brazilian Judge Orders Investigation Into JD Vance Donor Network
articles.body: A Brazilian judge ordered an investigation into a donor network linked to Vice President JD Vance over alleged aid to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign.

articles.headline: Trump to Greet Venezuelan Oil Shipment, Calling It a 'Gift'
articles.body: A discounted Venezuelan crude shipment is arriving in the U.S. as part of a deal with a firm controlled by a Venezuelan billionaire.

articles.headline: Grand Jury Declines to Indict Cassidy Hutchinson
articles.body: A grand jury declined to indict former White House aide Cassidy Hutchinson over her Jan. 6 committee testimony, her lawyers said.

articles.headline: Netanyahu Ahead but No Clear Winner in Israeli Election
articles.body: Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc was ahead but short of a clear majority after Israel's highest-turnout election in decades, setting up coalition talks.

articles.headline: Bolsonaro Lands in US After Fleeing Brazil
articles.body: The losing presidential candidate and son of jailed ex-president Jair Bolsonaro left Brazil after being ordered to hand over his passport.

articles.headline: At Least 68 Killed in Collision of High-Speed Trains in Spain
articles.body: A collision between high-speed trains in Spain killed at least 68 people, becoming one of Europe's deadliest rail accidents in recent years.

articles.headline: SK Hynix Profits Soar Amid Roaring AI Chip Demand
articles.body: SK hynix posted a record operating profit as AI-driven demand for memory chips, especially HBM, continued to roar.

articles.headline: Tech Stocks Gain as AI Trade Revives
articles.body: Technology stocks climbed as the AI trade revived, with semiconductor shares outperforming after Anthropic's IPO filing renewed enthusiasm.

articles.headline: Anthropic's Seven Founders Tighten Grip Ahead of Blockbuster IPO
articles.body: The seven founders of the Claude-maker are betting their future on staying united as they prepare for a blockbuster IPO that could value it at $2tn.
